title: Spectre.Console
description: Build beautiful, feature-rich console applications with Spectre.Console.

data.text: `Spectre.Console` is a .NET library for creating rich console applications with colors, tables, trees, prompts, spinners, and progress bars.
Use `AnsiConsole` to write colored and styled text, create tables, and show status indicators.

data.title: Console Tables and Colors

data.text: Spectre.Console provides progress bars and status spinners for long-running tasks.

data.title: Progress Bar Example

terms.definition: The main entry point for writing Spectre.Console output.
Rich text with BBCode-style tags like `[bold]` and `[green]`.
A rendered ASCII-style table with borders and columns.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use `AnsiConsole.Prompt` for interactive CLI inputs instead of raw Console.ReadLine.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Spectre.Console makes CLI apps visually appealing.
Tables, trees, and prompts are built in.
Progress bars and spinners improve UX for long tasks.
data.takeaway: Spectre.Console is the best way to build professional .NET CLI tools.

data.title: Exercise: Build a CLI Table App
data.description: Create a console app that displays a table of employees with Spectre.Console.
steps: Create a Table with Name, Department, and Salary columns.
Prompt the user for a new employee name.
data.expectedOutcome: You can build a polished, interactive console UI with Spectre.Console.
